versions.changelog: Keep the public package exactly synchronized with the canonical image-deck skill and improve discovery for PPT, presentation, and slides searches.
Improve discovery for PPT, presentation, and slides searches while keeping GPT Image 2 in the description and tags.
Add PPT, PowerPoint, slide-deck, image-generation, and GPT Image 2 discovery topics; preserve the existing title.
Improve PPT and PowerPoint search discovery while preserving the existing public title.
Improve discovery for PPT and PowerPoint searches by moving those keywords into the card summary and leading description.
Republish directly from the current local canonical image-deck directory, unchanged, and refresh all install tags.
Align the published skill exactly with the final local and GitHub canonical file set while retaining the PowerPoint native slide-number compatibility fix.
Fix native PowerPoint slide numbers by using standard slide-number placeholders across the master, layout, and slides.
Mirror the local image-deck skill exactly.
Remove page-number requirements from image generation and add native PowerPoint slide-number fields only during PPTX assembly.
Use concise, natural user-facing wording for overall-design and sample-style confirmations.
Require two distinct approvals: overall design confirmation, then sample-style confirmation before generating remaining slides.
Move the preview image before the install section and include it in SKILL.md for ClawHub display.
Add a hosted preview image to the README.
Remove the personal repository sentence from the public docs.
Default the text richness recommendation to information-rich while keeping balanced and concise modes available.
Add a text richness/content density choice and support concise-text slide generation mode.
Remove lightweight/deep research wording and keep the source step as read, extract, and research before planning.
Make the ClawHub display name start with image-deck and stop recommending a language during intake.
Improve slide search metadata by starting the display name and summary with Slide Deck / PPT wording.
Increase default information density for normal content slides and require recommended choices when asking page count, language, and style.
Add broader PPT/slide trigger wording, prevent prompt packages from being withdrawn and re-output, keep one confirmation gate, and publish the skill under skills/image-deck.
Keep cover text strict while allowing natural supporting detail text on content slides.
Soften cover guidance to allow tasteful supporting detail text when it improves the style.
Use one combined approval gate and relax small supporting text rules so rich report/editorial slides are not over-cleaned.
Improve display name for slide and PPT search discovery.
Improve search keywords and metadata for slide, presentation, PowerPoint, PPT, and PPTX discovery.
Add ClawHub page link to public install documentation.
Improve OpenClaw intake, slide design document review, and default text-rich slide guidance while respecting explicit low-text requests.
Put the user-facing README-style description at the top of SKILL.md for clearer ClawHub display.
Initial public release of image-deck.
